text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding things that could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you create mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to have contingency plans, which are actions you take if a risk actually occurs. Finally, monitoring is essential. You must watch risks regularly because situations change. Good risk management helps you avoid surprises and protects your goals.
